title: 第6章 许菲菲第7章 展露实力
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
砰！
陈锋直接一巴掌抽在了郭龙的脸上，直接将他抽的飞了出去。
郭龙在空中转悠了好几圈最后身体朝上脸朝下落了下来，狠狠的落在了地上，他的脸都被摔肿起来了不说牙齿也跌落了几颗，疼的他龇牙咧嘴惨叫起来。
而看到这一幕，郭少的几个狗腿子惊呆了，小姑妈惊呆了，所有在场的学生们都惊呆了，他们都不敢相信的看着这一幕。
要知道这郭龙不是普通人，而是黑二代啊。
“你敢打郭少？你疯了？”
“你疯了？郭少是楚州五口堂第五堂主的小公子啊，你敢得罪五口堂？”
……
此刻，郭龙的几个狗腿子则用手指着陈锋喊了起来，他们不明白为什么李峰这么大的胆子，竟然敢找郭少的麻烦，敢打黑帮的公子。
不过碍于陈锋力气大的惊人，他们也不敢动手。
“小峰，你怎么能打郭少了，我们惹不起他的。”
小姑妈陈泠汐也着急的很，她直接哭了起来，她可是清楚的知道郭龙背景的。
“小峰，这次你闯大祸了你赶紧走吧，这件事我来善后。”
陈泠汐哭泣起来，她用手推陈锋的身体，催促陈锋离开。
“啊小姑妈，你怎么处理？”
陈锋看了一眼趴在地上惨叫的郭龙，好奇的询问小姑妈。
“没事，大不了我陪陪郭少就是了，他知道他想得到我，本来我是不愿意的，不过现在……只剩牺牲下自己了。”
陈泠汐自言自语道，宝石一样的大眼睛里流下眼泪来。
陈泠汐虽然很不喜欢郭龙这二世祖，不过现在侄子打了对方，如果她不献身的话只怕五口堂的人会打死侄子的。
只有她献身成为了郭龙的女人，这样才能和郭龙说上话，让郭龙饶恕她侄子。

听到小姑妈的话，陈锋全身的血液涌动了起来，也很是感动。
小姑妈竟然为了自己，竟然要和这个畜生睡觉。
“小姑妈，你想多了，像他这种垃圾哪里伤的了我了，放心吧从今天开始你就看不到他了。”
陈锋深吸一口气后，他微微一笑，然后走向了郭龙。
“你别过来。”
看到陈锋走了过来，坐在地上的郭龙吓的不停，他原本以为陈锋是菜鸡，哪知道陈锋这么牛逼一巴掌将他拍飞出去，这是多么大的力气啊，这导致他两个狗腿子都不敢动手了。
如今看到陈锋走过来，郭龙自然害怕的很，害怕陈锋继续殴打他。
“放心吧，我不打你，我知道你不服气，现在给你一个机会你把你们五口堂最强最牛逼的给我叫来。”
陈锋对着他笑了笑，忽然丢给了郭龙一个苹果手机，示意他打电话叫人。
“你说真的？”
听到陈锋的话，郭龙顿时大喜，高兴的连鼻涕泡泡都冒了出来，他二话没说直接拿起手机拨打了一个电话，很快那边接通了。
“豹叔，我是郭龙，你快点带人过来，我在学校被人打了，你带人给我过来出气。”
content_en:
Bang!
Chen Feng slapped Guo Long directly on the face, sending him flying away.
Guo Long wandered around in the air for several times and finally fell face down, face up, and landed hard on the ground. His face was swollen, not to mention that he also lost a few teeth. He grinned and screamed in pain.
Seeing this scene, several of Mr. Guo's henchmen were stunned, the little aunt was stunned, and all the students present were stunned. They all looked at this scene in disbelief.
You must know that this Guo Long is not an ordinary person, but a second-generation gangster.
"You dare to hit Mr. Guo? Are you crazy?"
"Are you crazy? Mr. Guo is the young master of the fifth master of the Wukou Hall in Chuzhou. How dare you offend the Wukou Hall?"
…
At this moment, several of Guo Long's henchmen pointed at Chen Feng and shouted. They didn't understand why Li Feng was so bold and dared to cause trouble for Mr. Guo and hit the gangster.
However, due to Chen Feng's amazing strength, they did not dare to take action.
"Xiao Feng, how could you hit Mr. Guo? We can't afford to offend him."
The younger aunt Chen Lingxi was also very anxious. She started crying. She knew Guo Long's background clearly.
"Xiao Feng, you got into big trouble this time. You should leave quickly. I will take care of the aftermath."
Chen Lingxi started crying. She pushed Chen Feng's body with her hands, urging Chen Feng to leave.
"Ah, little aunt, how do you deal with it?"
Chen Feng glanced at Guo Long, who was lying on the ground screaming, and curiously asked his little aunt.
"It's okay. At worst, I just need to accompany Mr. Guo. He knows he wants me. I was not willing to get it at first, but now... all I have to do is sacrifice myself."
Chen Lingxi muttered to herself, tears streaming from her big jewel-like eyes.
Although Chen Lingxi disliked Guo Long, her second generation ancestor, now that her nephew had beaten her, if she didn't sacrifice herself, she was afraid that the people from Wukoutang would beat her nephew to death.
Only by dedicating herself to become Guo Long's woman can she speak to Guo Long and ask Guo Long to forgive her nephew.
Hearing what his little aunt said, Chen Feng's blood surged all over his body and he was very moved.
My little aunt actually wanted to sleep with this beast for her own sake.
"Little aunt, you are overthinking. How could trash like him hurt me? Don't worry, you won't be able to see him from today on."
After Chen Feng took a deep breath, he smiled slightly and then walked towards Guo Long.
"Don't come here."
Seeing Chen Feng coming over, Guo Long, who was sitting on the ground, was frightened. He originally thought that Chen Feng was a rookie, but he didn't know that Chen Feng was so awesome and slapped him away. It was such a powerful force that the two henchmen did not dare to do anything.
Now that he saw Chen Feng approaching, Guo Long was naturally very scared, afraid that Chen Feng would continue to beat him.
"Don't worry, I won't hit you. I know you're not convinced. Now I'll give you a chance. Call me the strongest and most awesome person in your family of five."
Chen Feng smiled at him and suddenly threw an iPhone to Guo Long, indicating to him to call someone.
"Are you serious?"
Hearing Chen Feng's words, Guo Long was overjoyed. He was so happy that snot bubbles came out of his nose. Without saying anything, he picked up his cell phone and dialed a number, and the call was quickly connected.
"Uncle Bao, I am Guo Long. Please bring someone here quickly. I was beaten at school. Please bring someone here to vent my anger."
